description: Reply to a specific message in a conversation on any connected platform (WhatsApp, website chat, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, …). Also replies inside a WhatsApp group when "phone" is the group's chat_id from get_groups (QR-connected numbers only), optionally tagging members with "mentions".

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this reply.

mentions.description: Optional, WhatsApp groups on a QR-connected number only. Group members to tag (@mention) so WhatsApp highlights their name and notifies them: phone numbers in international format without + (e.g. "5511970793770") or member ids from WhatsApp (e.g. "5511970793770@s.whatsapp.net", "123456789012345@lid"). A member whose @<number> is not already in the text gets it added at the start automatically. Every @<number> already written in the text is tagged too, so this list is optional when the text names them. Max 50.

message_id.description: The WhatsApp message ID to reply to

phone.description: WhatsApp number in international format without +, or the contact's phone / chat_id as listed. To reply inside a WhatsApp group, the group's "chat_id" from get_groups (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us).

text.description: The reply text. In a group, every "@<number>" (international format, e.g. @5511970793770) tags that member.

name: reply_to_message
